dedupe_keys.name: the supplementary data for the mainland china residential building stock modeling work of xin et al

description: The supplementary data for the mainland China residential building stock modeling work of Xin et al. is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Danhua Xin, James Edward Daniell (Southern University of Science and Technology). The gird level residential building stock model (in terms of floor area and replacement value) developed by Xin et al. (2021), the comparison figures/table between modeled results and census records, and the Matlab script illustrating part of the modeling process are available here. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
